description: Only after the user confirms what they did: record that they picked, switched to or reverted from a replacement path. Adds one to anonymous public counters and stores no personal data. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses). Tool results are summarized; exit tools log only result counts, qualification flags and public evidence statuses, not answer contents. Don't send personal data or secrets.
name: report_outcome
title: Report what the user did
